summary: NCCL Fast Socket improves NCCL performance for multi-GPU workloads on GKE Standard clusters.

supporting_pages.title: "MCP Tools Reference: container.googleapis.com \_|\_ Google Kubernetes Engine\
evidence_snippets: By default, GKE enables multi-NIC support, which allows the Lustre CSI driver to automatically detect and configure all suitable network interfaces on a node to maximize I/O performance for demanding workloads.
Union field fast socket . fast socket can be only one of the following: fastSocket object ( FastSocket ) Enable or disable NCCL fast socket for the node pool.
